offices.text: inflames men with women's love and women with men's
when commanded, willingly discloses the secrets of women, mocking them

notes.text: 1904: 'causeth them also to show themselves naked'; Weyer's reading prevails

goetia.textus: (12.) Sitri. —The Twelfth Spirit is Sitri. He is a Great Prince and appeareth at first with a Leopard’s head and the Wings of a Gryphon, but after the command of the Master of the Exorcism he putteth on Human shape, and that very beautiful. He enflameth men with Women’s love, and Women with Men’s love; and causeth them also to show themselves naked if it be desired. He governeth 60 Legions of Spirits. His Seal is this, to be worn as a Lamen before thee, etc.
forma: He is a Great Prince and appeareth at first with a Leopard’s head and the Wings of a Gryphon, but after the command of the Master of the Exorcism he putteth on Human shape, and that very beautiful.

reticentia: the witnesses are silent on his truthfulness
